Text:
[II] Lord, together with every holy woman, we pray for the Church, saying:
[IR] Lord, remember Your Church.
[I1] Through every woman, who sow life and courage into their friends and neighbors,
[I2] grant Your Church to inspire us all to courageously live for others.
[I1] Through everyone who mothers, whose loving devotion nurtures life, wisdom and hope into all under her care,
[I2] grant Your Church to mother all people into new life, transformed minds and eternal hope.
[I1] Through every widow, whose prayers and hospitality embody their journeys with love and loss,
[I2] grant Your Church to welcome and bless everyone in every season of life.
[I1] Through every women martyr, who followed You into death carrying her cross with strength of spirit,
[I2] grant Your Church their courage amidst every trial.
[I1] Through every holy woman, who heard You call them by name, responded with faith and now look upon Your face in glory,
[I2] grant the deceased to gaze upon that same vision and rejoice with them forever.
Changes: 2026-07-17 - Paul Prins: Initial translation of these intentions.
